agentPluginGate.updated: Plugin updated. Restart your sessions to apply.
agentPluginGate.installed: Plugin installed. Restart your sessions to apply.
agentPluginGate.codexTrust: Codex: run /hooks in a Codex session to trust the plugin's hooks.
agentPluginGate.title: Enable the agent integration
agentPluginGate.description: The lich plugin reports your sessions' status and titles to the app, refreshes their git status, and lets a restored session resume its conversation. Install it into the CLIs you use.

emptySessions.title: No session open
emptySessions.description: Open a session to start working in this project.
emptySessions.noAgent: No agent found on PATH, so this opens a terminal — set one in Settings › Providers.

footerSession.costNote: API cost across this session's conversations. Subscription charges may differ.

gitMissingGate.title: git is not installed
gitMissingGate.description: lich reads every branch, diff and worktree through git. Sessions still run without it — the version control surfaces stay empty.

home.title: No project open
home.description: Open a folder to start a terminal session.

notificationsOptIn.title: Notify you when a session needs you?

providerSetupDialog.chooseDescription: lich found these on your machine. Turn on the ones you use — the rest stay out of the New Session menu.
providerSetupDialog.noneDescription: lich runs the agents already installed on your machine, and found none. Install one, then check again.
providerSetupDialog.changeLater: You can change this any time in Settings › Providers.
providerSetupDialog.pointToBinary: Already have one installed? Point lich at its binary in Settings › Providers.

resumeSessionDialog.title: Resume previous session?
resumeSessionDialog.description: {label} left a conversation behind ({id}). Resume it to pick the conversation up where it stopped, or start new for an empty one.

running.one: {count} session is running. In the background it keeps working, and opening lich again brings it back on screen.
running.other: {count} sessions are running. In the background they keep working, and opening lich again brings them back on screen.

services.one: {count} service is running. In the background it keeps running, and quitting lich stops it.
services.other: {count} services are running. In the background they keep running, and quitting lich stops them.

servicesToo.one: {count} service is running too, and quitting lich stops it.
servicesToo.other: {count} services are running too, and quitting lich stops them.

uncleanExitGate.title: lich's previous run ended unexpectedly
uncleanExitGate.description: Your sessions were restored, but whatever they were running stopped with it.

updateProgressToast.reopens: lich closes and reopens on its own.

projects.noLongerAvailable: {label} is no longer available to resume

windowClose.countFailed: Could not count the running sessions: {error}

main.lostTitle: Another lich window took over, or lich quit.

notifyPrompt.description: A session just asked for your input while you were somewhere else. lich can raise a desktop notification when that happens, naming the session and its project, so you can start something and walk away from the window. Sessions you are looking at never notify. You can change this any time in Settings › General.
